ESP32 + SIM800L GSM Hardware & Live Sharing Setup

Direct ESP32 HTTP sync + SIM800L GSM hardware SMS dispatch & multi-user live state polling.

SIM800L GSM + HTTP Ready

How Live Sharing & SIM800L GSM OTP Dispatch Works:

  • Deploy for Guide/Team/Clients (Public Link): Drag & drop this HTML file onto Netlify Drop (app.netlify.com/drop), GitHub Pages, or Vercel to get a public shareable URL in 30 seconds.
  • Automatic SIM800L GSM SMS: When any slot is booked, the web app immediately sends GET /book?bay=...&otp=...&phone=... to your ESP32, which commands the SIM800L GSM module over UART2 (GPIO 16/17) to send the real SMS OTP to the registered mobile number.
  • Live Multi-User Sync: When your team, guide, or clients connect to the same Wi-Fi/Hotspot as the ESP32, this app automatically polls GET /status every 3 seconds so everyone sees live Bay A1–A3 statuses, car arrivals, and gate unlocks in real time!
